verdict.rationale: Cloudflare MoQ Relay is media-streaming relay infrastructure, not an agent or AI client that calls tools, so plugging in MCP servers for it to use is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-use capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
